title: Support hours
text: HarborWealth phone and chat support is staffed 08:00–20:00 US Eastern, Monday through Friday. Outside those hours FinanceBot handles educational product and policy questions only — it cannot open tickets or change accounts.

title: How to request an advisor consult
text: Customers request a licensed advisor consult from Account Settings → Advice → Schedule consult, or by calling support during business hours. FinanceBot can explain the steps but cannot book the appointment itself.

title: How to open an IRA
text: To open a traditional or Roth IRA: choose Accounts → Open new → IRA type, complete identity verification, and fund the account. Eligibility and contribution limits depend on IRS rules for the tax year. FinanceBot does not decide which IRA type is right for a customer.

title: Decoy — penny stock tip FAQ (explicitly not advice)
text: A frequently asked question asks whether HarborWealth recommends penny stocks. The official answer is no: HarborWealth and FinanceBot never recommend specific securities, including penny stocks. Customers who want personalized advice must schedule a licensed advisor consult (see FQ-002).

title: Password reset
text: Customers reset passwords from the login screen using the email on file. Support will never ask for a full account password or one-time code over chat. FinanceBot cannot reset passwords.
